english_draft:
Samsung Electronics is expected to publish fourth-quarter 2025 results around late January 2026. This preview is a historical reconstruction. It was not written before the earnings release. It uses only the official third-quarter 2025 release published on October 30, 2025.

Base quarter (Q3 2025)
Consolidated revenue was KRW 86.1 trillion. Consolidated operating profit was KRW 12.2 trillion. The Device Solutions (DS) Division posted revenue of KRW 33.1 trillion and operating profit of KRW 7.0 trillion. The Memory Business achieved record quarterly revenue. HBM3E was in mass production. HBM4 samples were shipped to key clients. Foundry earnings improved significantly. The MX and Networks Businesses posted revenue of KRW 34.1 trillion and operating profit of KRW 3.6 trillion. Samsung Display Corporation posted revenue of KRW 8.1 trillion and operating profit of KRW 1.2 trillion. The Visual Display and Digital Appliances Businesses posted revenue of KRW 13.9 trillion and an operating loss of KRW 0.1 trillion.

Core questions for Q4 2025
First, can AI memory demand sustain the Memory Business record? The company plans to sell more HBM3E, high-density eSSDs, DDR5 and GDDR7 products in Q4.
Second, can Foundry continue its earnings improvement? Q3 improvement came from lower one-off costs and better fab utilization. Q4 performance depends on 2nm Gate-All-Around mass-production ramp-up and cost optimization.
Third, can MX offset the Visual Display loss? MX plans seasonal promotions for Galaxy S25 and foldables to achieve year-on-year growth. VD plans premium and large-screen TV promotions to restore revenue.

Expectation gaps
These gaps are relative to the company's own guidance, not to third-party consensus. Positive gaps: faster HBM4 ramp, foundry order conversion, QD-OLED monitor expansion, TV seasonal demand. Negative gaps: System LSI customer inventory adjustments, VD price competition, rising material costs.

Verification points
Check consolidated revenue and operating profit against the KRW 86.1 trillion and KRW 12.2 trillion baseline. Check DS operating profit expansion. Check Memory sales record. Check Foundry improvement. Check MX year-on-year growth. Check VD revenue recovery and loss reduction.

Analysis
No contemporaneous preview existed, because this document is a retrospective reconstruction. Actual Q4 2025 results are outside the cutoff. The source contains no third-party consensus. Therefore, this analysis does not compare actuals with the preview. The only reference is the company's Q4 guidance in the Q3 release. Follow-up should compare the official Q4 report with that guidance when published.
